auditFinding.gap: The Pages builder verified the four-edition registry but did not stage accepted edition bytes into the shared artifact.
auditFinding.risk: Four accepted metadata entries could unlock downloads without proving that both public origins received the exact installer, checksum, signature, and receipt bytes.

implementation.websiteGenerationPolicy: copy or HTTPS-fetch exact handed-off bytes; never rebuild, rename, or synthesize edition assets

sharedArtifactContract.singleBuild: Pages produces one commit-pinned dronedream-shared-static-site artifact.
sharedArtifactContract.editionManifest: downloads/edition-artifacts.json is embedded in build-manifest.json with JSON depth 8.
sharedArtifactContract.integrity: SHA256SUMS covers every staged edition file and every other shared-artifact file.
sharedArtifactContract.pagesAndAliyun: Aliyun consumes the downloaded commit-pinned Pages artifact; it does not rebuild the site or installers.
sharedArtifactContract.publicRedownload: verify-site-parity.ps1 downloads every edition manifest path from both origins and checks it against the identical SHA256SUMS.
sharedArtifactContract.currentProductionState: All four editions remain awaiting-exact-handoff and produce zero edition publication inputs.

githubPages: retain the formal commit-pinned artifact for 30 days
redeploy the prior known-good source and artifact through the Pages workflow
rerun public manifest and file parity
aliyun: activate through an atomic current symlink
restore the previous symlink automatically when activation probes fail
run the two-origin parity verifier after any rollback

focusedTests.command: npm.cmd --prefix frontend test -- EditionAvailability.test.ts EditionReleaseRegistry.test.ts ProductPage.test.tsx PublicSite.test.tsx

validation.fullPagesBuild: not run; this bounded GREEN audit exercised the edition staging path with local synthetic bytes and performed no network release fetch
